definitions.jump_edge: the single primary edge C_k -> A_(k+1), cardinality 1
definitions.layer_occupancy_interval: I_k={n in Z: A_k<=n<A_(k+1)} when A_(k+1)<infinity
definitions.nonreaching_case: If k is reached but k+1 is never reached, then the k-layer occupancy is infinite and C_k is undefined.

gap_freedom_theorem.consequence: For each k>=1, the finite primary layer gap g_k is free over all positive integers; existing Stage-X/Y semantics do not determine g_k=2k+1 or any other function of k.
gap_freedom_theorem.construction: Set A_0=0, A_1=1, recursively A_(k+1)=A_k+g_k. Define a_n=k on A_k<=n<A_(k+1). Then every increment is 0 except the last edge of each layer, where it is 1.
gap_freedom_theorem.statement: For every sequence (g_k)_{k>=1} of positive integers, there exists an allowed binary staircase with A_0=0, A_1=1 and A_(k+1)-A_k=g_k for every k>=1. A terminal infinite plateau is also allowed.
gap_freedom_theorem.use_of_frozen_input: Stage X states that every such binary staircase extends to a global self-consistent UNIT_STEP atlas.

phase_distinction.activation_phase: frontier F2(k) could only be tied to the interval before A_(k+1) if an independent correspondence is proved
phase_distinction.completion_phase: C_k is the final index in layer k; the completion-to-activation edge itself has cardinality 1
phase_distinction.no_phase_selected: No current theorem selects I_k or the jump edge as the native frontier-consuming event set.
